# TopologyDrivenRouting

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Routing decisions influenced by the evolving local topology and path multiplicity, rather than fixed global routing tables. Aligns with in-network neuromorphic processing, where routing and computation are co-adaptive to structural changes.
